source: &731 Those goons'll see me before I even get close!
target: &731 还没走近，那些打手就会看到我！

source: &732 There must be another way on-board...
target: &732 肯定还有别的路能上去……

source: &752 The cargo hangar, though rickety, is probably the safest place on this airfield.
target: &752 货运机库虽然破破烂烂，却可能是整个机场最安全的地方。

source: &753 The way the containers are spread out between the hangar and the aerostat, you guess they're in the middle of loading.
target: &753 集装箱散布在机库和浮空艇之间，看样子他们正在装货。

source: &754 The aerostat hangs a metre from the ground, ready to break free from the Earth once its cables are released. This is apparently where they're hiding...
target: &754 浮空艇悬在离地一米的地方，只要解开缆绳，就能升空。他们显然就藏在那里……

source: &588 I can't just walk out there, the goons on the pad'll see me for sure!
target: &588 不能直接走出去。停机坪上的打手肯定会看见我！

source: &589 I need to find a way to get on-board undetected...
&755 After being moved from the hangar, it looks like the crates are sealed for transit - you can't find a way into these ones.
target: &755 箱子从机库运出来后，似乎已经封好，准备运输。你找不到能钻进去的地方。

source: &735 It looks like they're expecting trouble.
